Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: Assembled an invalid party that violates multiple clues: only one plate wearer instead of two, only one DPS capable of “ice or fire” (Mage) instead of two different DPS, and forced Metamorphosis via Demon Hunter which breaks the armor-count constraint. They also ignored that the “bear” clue requires a Druid/Hunter while still needing a separate Metamorphosis user. The correct consistent set is Death Knight (ice), Druid (bear), Paladin (holy tank), Priest (holy healer), Warlock (fire + Metamorphosis), also explaining why a mail “Kilt of the Forgotten One” can’t be used.
